head: d86c254
proposals: Test wider recruitment restricted to fixed-entry buffers with the same12m floor. The60m prototype is not production qualification.
Do not adopt speed-band or station-local formation restrictions on this two-seed screen.
Any below12m spacing requires a pair-specific low-speed certificate, bounded transition to ordinary clearance, and reviewed safety/save contracts.
limitations: Samples are1Hz and do not give exact assignment timestamps.
Formation restrictions do not reduce the physical gap floor and do not end existing links.
All heavy means and tails exclude skipped offers.
Synthetic held berth uses an external reservation absent from saved state. Restore tests certificate placement, not persistence of that blocker.
Synthetic restored continuation is one second, not full discharge qualification.
Physical restore resets speed and may rebuild reservations. No identical-future claim.
A two-seed functional screen cannot establish production capacity gain.
